solvers.label: CalculiX
post_commands: printf 'max_displacement_mm=' && grep -o 'U[[:space:]]*[0-9.]*' cantilever.dat 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}' || true
printf 'max_von_mises_mpa=' && grep -o 'S[[:space:]]*[0-9.]*' cantilever.dat 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}' || true

input_files.cantilever.inp:
*HEADING
SimFEA Studio CalculiX adapter smoke case (N, mm, MPa)
*NODE
1, 0., 0., 0.
2, 1000., 0., 0.
*ELEMENT, TYPE=B31, ELSET=beam
1, 1, 2
*MATERIAL, NAME=steel
*ELASTIC
210000., 0.3
*BEAM SECTION, ELSET=beam, MATERIAL=steel, SECTION=RECT
20., 20.
0., 0., 1.
*BOUNDARY
1, 1, 6
*STEP
*STATIC
*CLOAD
2, 2, -100.
*NODE FILE
U
*EL FILE, ELSET=beam
S
*END STEP

solvers.label: OpenFOAM
solvers.description: OpenFOAM adapter. Replace input_files with a real case before production runs.
solvers.command_template: foamDictionary -help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo 'OpenFOAM adapter ready'; touch result.txt

input_files.README.simfea.txt: OpenFOAM adapter placeholder. Replace input_files with a real OpenFOAM case in .simfea/config.json.

input_files.case.sif:
Header
  CHECK KEYWORDS Warn
End
Simulation
  Max Output Level = 3
  Coordinate System = Cartesian
  Simulation Type = Steady State
  Steady State Max Iterations = 1
  Output File = case.result
End
